Question: Between Amazing Stories and Aquarium Fish International, which magazine is devoted more to hobbies related to physical activities?
Thought 1: I need to search Amazing Stories and Aquarium Fish International, find what they are devoted to, then find which one is devoted more to hobbies related to physical activities.
Action 1: Search[Amazing Stories]
Observation 1: Amazing Stories is an American science fiction magazine launched in April 1926 by Hugo Gernsback's Experimenter Publishing. It was the first magazine devoted solely to science fiction. Science fiction stories had made regular appearances in other magazines, including some published by Gernsback, but Amazing helped define and launch a new genre of pulp fiction.. As of 2024,[update] Amazing has been published, with some interruptions, for 98 years, going through a half-dozen owners and many editors as it struggled to be profitable. Gernsback was forced into bankruptcy and lost control of the magazine in 1929.
Thought 2: Amazing Stories is devoted to science fiction. I need to search Aquarium Fish International next.
Action 2: Search[Aquarium Fish International]
Observation 2: Aquarium Fish International (AFI) was a North American monthly magazine, published by BowTie Inc. of Irvine, California, and dedicated to freshwater and saltwater fishkeeping and the aquarium/fishkeeping hobby in general.. Originally titled Aquarium Fish Magazine (AFM),[2] the first issue of the magazine was in October 1988. The title of the publication changed slightly beginning with the February 2007 issue; the new title was Aquarium Fish International. It had a circulation of 31,170.[1] In June 2010, the former Freshwater and Marine Aquarium magazine ceased publication, and several of its columns were merged into AFI.[3] Aquarium Fish International abruptly ceased publication in October 2012.[2][4].
Thought 3: Aquarium Fish International is devoted to fishkeeping and the aquarium/fishkeeping hobby. Science fiction is not a physical activity. Fishkeeping is a hobby, but it is not typically considered a physical activity. Therefore, neither magazine is devoted more to hobbies related to physical activities.
Action 3: Finish[null]
